title: Winner at Hackathon at Nomia Limited
description: Traditional keyword-based search fails when users describe what they're looking for in their own words instead of using exact product terms — leading to poor category matches and frustrated users. So I built A semantic search engine that maps natural-language product descriptions to the correct product category using vector embeddings, instead of relying on keyword matching.
short_description: Traditional keyword search fails when users describe products in their own words. I built a semantic search engine that accurately maps natural-language descriptions to correct product categories using vector embeddings.
